sources.snippet: Vision-language models (VLMs) pretrained on large-scale multimodal datasets encode rich visual and linguistic knowledge, making them a strong foundation for robotics. Rather than training robotic policies from scratch, recent approaches adapt VLMs into vision-language-action (VLA) models that enable natural language-driven perception and control. sources.title: SmolVLA | Robots Atlas
sources.snippet: Overview SmolVLA is a compact (450M-parameter), open-source Vision-Language-Action model built by Hugging Face within the LeRobot ecosystem. It takes a sequence of RGB images from multiple cameras, the robot's current sensorimotor state, and a natural-language instruction, and outputs a continuous sequence of actions (an action chunk) to control the robot.
